body.name: faceted PEC swept-wing skin
body.construction: triangulate the nine listed upper-skin stations with straight edges; do not smooth the spanwise break
body.surface_rule: at each station y=y_leading_edge-fraction*chord and z=z_skin+[0,mid_chord_camber,0]
body.surface_mesh_requirement: the Assembly validation mesh must use the identical vertices, triangle diagonals, hard edges, and global coordinates as the clean full-wave model

featured_geometry.host: the 0.64-chord polyline through all three span stations
featured_geometry.normal_rule: use the outward normal of the specified incident aft-side triangle for each segment; preserve the normal discontinuity at the middle station
featured_geometry.line_delta_requirement: feature-centered matched clean/featured 2-D coupons; complex OPN-FRD

featured_geometry.host: outboard forward skin triangle, strictly inside its edges
featured_geometry.location_rule: barycentric weights [0.22,0.33,0.45] on the outboard forward cell's aft triangle
featured_geometry.roll_rule: project the triangle's first directed edge into the tangent plane
featured_geometry.explicit_geometry: 8 mm diameter, 2 mm high PEC circular cap installed into the skin
featured_geometry.point_delta_requirement: matching local 3-D installed and clean-skin patches; installed-minus-clean complex Jones field at the stated phase center

mandatory_controls: confirm all four artifacts have byte-identical coordinate grids and convention metadata
compare clean baseline, featured total, and isolated complex feature delta
split each hinge segment in half without moving the path and require numerical invariance
reverse the hinge path and apply the documented coupon-orientation transformation
translate the hinge 20 mm chordwise in both explicit and reconstructed models
rotate the fastener roll 45 degrees in both explicit and reconstructed models
report mesh-convergence change separately from reconstruction error
